units.source_text: 头疼万分，像戴了顶铅的帽子，帽檐唰地滑落到眼睛之上……

en.t: His head ached terribly, as if he were wearing a leaden hat whose brim had suddenly slipped down over his eyes...

units.source_text: 情欲，最终好像只是缩短了达到破灭的距离。

en.t: Desire, in the end, seemed only to shorten the distance to ruin.

units.source_text: 突然，男人趴下了，像狗一样扒着泥地间的沙地。

en.t: Suddenly, the man dropped to the ground and, like a dog, scratched at the sand between the patches of mud.

units.source_text: 挖了一个肘部那么深的洞，沙子黑黑的，透出了潮湿的气味。

en.t: He dug a hole about elbow deep; the sand was dark and gave off a damp smell.

units.source_text: 他把脸摁进洞里，把发烧的额头贴上去，胸中吸满了沙子气味。

en.t: He pressed his face into the hole, laid his feverish forehead against it, and filled his chest with the smell of sand.

units.source_text: 弄得好的话，说不定胃里的氧气和氢气能化合呢。

en.t: If things went well, perhaps the oxygen and hydrogen in his stomach might combine.
